requirements.text: Each microstate must contain exactly eight binary bits in E1,E2,E3,I1,I2,I3,V1,V2 order.
The engine must compute e, i, v, En, Cp, Cr, Ci, Ck, C, H, phase, readiness, and engine projection from the raw microstate.
The phase partition must be total and reproduce collapsed 37, strained 153, transitional 56, coherent 3, integrated 7.
The engine projection must use Cr>=2/3 as the structural-lock bit and reproduce the frozen sixteen-engine occupancy.
N, S, E, W, and M_score must be computed internally from the source and target microstates.
HFnum must be derived internally from Hamming distance, target low-coherence/high-entropy collapse, and phase regression greater than one level.
evaluate_edge must not accept caller-supplied m_score or hf_num authority.
All 65,536 ordered microstate pairs must return a bounded M_score and defined Boolean HFnum.
Every edge must validate exactly one corresponding receipt for each of the fifteen governance predicates.
Every edge must validate one corresponding semantic adjudication receipt and must not infer a favorable route class from the numeric score.
Closure terminal diagnostics must be derived from the actual terminal microstate, not supplied as an unaudited terminal summary.
advance_lifecycle must not accept a caller-supplied receipt_valid Boolean.
Lifecycle advancement must validate the actual receipt hash, record type, status, identity, correspondence, and required predecessor chain.
A tampered lifecycle receipt may not advance the lifecycle.
A lifecycle receipt with mismatched object or context identity may not advance the lifecycle.
Lifecycle stages may not be skipped by presenting a later receipt type.
HOME must preserve invariant, name, sequence, terminal identity, and owner choice.
Final closure may not be issued without exactly one valid GLOCK, provisional seal, and HOME receipt.
Public and internal closure claims must remain exactly stage-bound.

Executable conformance must not be represented as empirical validation, domain validation, autonomous semantic inference, issuer-signature trust, external mathematical review, or universal reachability.
